/** Death protection allows zero HP; use this check when handling player defeat. */
export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  return character.hp <= 0 && !character.invincible;
}

/** Add or remove shield points, capped by max HP without changing health. */
export function changePlayerShield(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount)) {
    character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield + Math.trunc(amount)));
  }
}

// The runtime item effect registers once; plain stat consumers need no world dependencies.
let playerDamageGuard=null;
export function setPlayerDamageGuard(guard){playerDamageGuard=guard;}
/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula([].concat(character.damageReductionPercent??[],lifeJacketStats(character)?.reduction??0)));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};showDamageNumber(character,0,true,'miss');return false;}
  const initialFraction=chiseDelayConfigured()?chiseImmediateFraction(character):1;
  const immediate=Math.round(damage*initialFraction),deferred=damage-immediate;
  if(deferred>0){
    if(!(character.chisePendingDamage>0))character.chiseTickElapsed=0;
    character.chisePendingDamage=(character.chisePendingDamage||0)+deferred;
  }
  const taken=applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,immediate);
  character.lastDamageResult.deferredDamage=deferred;
  return taken||deferred>0;
}

/** Already-resolved damage bypasses attack-only negation, DR and Chise re-deferral. */
export function applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,damage){
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if(!Number.isFinite(damage)||damage<=0){character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};return false;}
  const jacket=character.lifeJacketState;
  const jacketAbsorbed=Math.min(jacket?.remaining??0,damage);
  if(jacket){jacket.remaining-=jacketAbsorbed;if(jacket.remaining<jacket.capacity)jacket.healElapsed=0;}
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage-jacketAbsorbed);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - jacketAbsorbed - absorbed));
  const healthDamage=previous-character.hp;
  const taken = jacketAbsorbed + absorbed + healthDamage;
  character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage,shieldDamage:jacketAbsorbed+absorbed};
  if (taken > 0) {
    if(healthDamage>0)character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    const shieldDamage=jacketAbsorbed+absorbed;
    if(shieldDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,shieldDamage,true,'shield');
    if(healthDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,healthDamage,true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

/** Boss action state, projectiles and warned area attacks; Shiroko keeps ordinary chase AI. */
export function createBossBehaviors({random=Math.random}={}) {
  const bullets=[],zones=[],warnings=new Map(),landingShadows=new Map(),movement=createSteadyMovementTracker();

    if (activeCharacter.transition) activeCharacter.transition.elapsed += delta * 1000;
    const playerBefore = { x: activeCharacter.x, y: activeCharacter.y };
    updateCharacter(activeCharacter, delta, direction);
    const playerMotion = { x: activeCharacter.x - playerBefore.x, y: activeCharacter.y - playerBefore.y };
    activeCharacter.stationaryForTuning=Math.hypot(playerMotion.x,playerMotion.y)<1e-6;
    updateCamera(delta);
    npcTools?.cleanup(); // Reclaim distant/invalid NPC slots before the next spawn batch.
    if (campaignSettings.enabled && !endlessMode && !pendingStageTransition && !isPlayerDefeated(activeCharacter)) {

/** Apply one pickup's reward without coupling inventory to the controlled avatar. */
function collectDrop(drop, player) {
  drops.delete(drop.id);
  if (drop.kind === 'exp') addPlayerExp(player, drop.value);
  else lootTotals[drop.kind] += drop.value;
}

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;
    enemy.moving=false;return true; // Freeze also holds knockback and attack timers.
  }
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if(stunned)enemy.stunVisualElapsed=(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)+delta;
  else delete enemy.stunVisualElapsed;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
/** Heal without exceeding maximum HP; works while invincible. */
export function healPlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
    character.hp = Math.min(character.maxHp, character.hp + Math.floor(amount));
  }
}

export function createPlayerStatsTools(getPlayer, onChange) {

import { totalPlayerShield, syncLifeJacketShield, syncRacerPassHealth } from './item-catalog.js';
import { createBitmapText, glyphRectangle } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { getLootTotals } from './exp-drops.js';
import { getKillCount } from './world-state.js';
import { applyEnhancedWeaponGlow } from './weapon-glow.js';
import { drawSynergyIcon } from './synergy-icon.js';

/** Reserve only visible caption ink, accounting for the slot art's top padding. */
export function levelCaptionSpacing(slotWidth, text) {
  const glyphs = [...text].filter(letter => letter !== ' ').map(glyphRectangle);
  const textWidth = [...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
    (letter === ' ' ? 3 : glyphRectangle(letter).width - 1), 1);
  const inkBottom = Math.max(...glyphs.map(glyph => glyph.offsetY + glyph.height));
  const nextBoxInset = slotWidth * (1 - 237 / 255) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, slotWidth * 0.9 * inkBottom / textWidth - 6 - nextBoxInset);
}

/** Keep the equipment frame 2px below the lowest visible attack-level outline. */
function updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries) {
  const visible=entries.filter(entry=>!entry.caption.hidden);
  if(!visible.length){container.style.setProperty('--level-space','0px');return;}
  const textWidth=text=>[...text].reduce((sum,letter)=>sum+(letter===' '?3:glyphRectangle(letter).width-1),1);
  // Scale the entire row together. Fitting each label independently makes LV1 and LV7
  // different heights because their digit glyphs have different widths.
  const scale=Math.min(...visible.map(entry=>entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*.9/textWidth(entry.captionText)));
  let spacing = 0;
  for (const entry of visible) {
    entry.caption.style.width=`${textWidth(entry.captionText)*scale}px`;
    entry.caption.style.height=`${20*scale}px`;
    const inkBottom=Math.max(...[...entry.captionText].filter(letter=>letter!==' ').map(letter=>{
      const glyph=glyphRectangle(letter);return glyph.offsetY+glyph.height;
    }));
    const nextBoxInset=entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*(1-237/255)/2;
    spacing=Math.max(spacing,inkBottom*scale-6-nextBoxInset);
  }
  container.style.setProperty('--level-space', `${spacing}px`);
}

  const key = `orbitrail:dev-settings:${location.pathname}`;

  const write = (name, value) => { try { sessionStorage.setItem(name, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch {} };

/** Fit source artwork into the ground footprint without distorting its proportions. */
export function tuningGroundSpriteBounds(image,x,y,size=tuningPartSettings.groundSize){
  const scale=size/Math.max(image.naturalWidth,image.naturalHeight);
  const width=image.naturalWidth*scale,height=image.naturalHeight*scale;

}

/** Exact connectors from weapon bottom to each slot top, in diagram-local pixels. */
export function tuningLinkEndpoints(weapon,slots,diagram){
  const start={x:(weapon.left+weapon.right)/2-diagram.left,y:weapon.bottom-diagram.top};

}

Additionally, the persistent damage from the Overheated Overclocking does not cause the buff to be removed.

/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount, {projectile=false}={}) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if(character.supportState?.invulnerableRemaining>0||(projectile&&character.supportState?.shieldRemaining>0)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};return false;}
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula([].concat(character.damageReductionPercent??[],lifeJacketStats(character)?.reduction??0)));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};showDamageNumber(character,0,true,'miss');return false;}
  const initialFraction=chiseDelayConfigured()?chiseImmediateFraction(character):1;
  const immediate=Math.round(damage*initialFraction),deferred=damage-immediate;
  if(deferred>0){
    if(!(character.chisePendingDamage>0))character.chiseTickElapsed=0;
    character.chisePendingDamage=(character.chisePendingDamage||0)+deferred;
  }
  const taken=applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,immediate);
  character.lastDamageResult.deferredDamage=deferred;
  return taken||deferred>0;
}

/** Already-resolved damage bypasses attack-only negation, DR and Chise re-deferral. */
export function applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,damage){
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if(!Number.isFinite(damage)||damage<=0){character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};return false;}
  const jacket=character.lifeJacketState;
  const jacketAbsorbed=Math.min(jacket?.remaining??0,damage);
  if(jacket){jacket.remaining-=jacketAbsorbed;if(jacket.remaining<jacket.capacity)jacket.healElapsed=0;}
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage-jacketAbsorbed);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - jacketAbsorbed - absorbed));
  const healthDamage=previous-character.hp;
  const taken = jacketAbsorbed + absorbed + healthDamage;
  character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage,shieldDamage:jacketAbsorbed+absorbed};
  if (taken > 0) {
    if(healthDamage>0)character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    const shieldDamage=jacketAbsorbed+absorbed;
    if(shieldDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,shieldDamage,true,'shield');
    if(healthDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,healthDamage,true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {

}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {

  return percentBonusFormula(value+(key==='spdPercent'?(character.baseSPD??100)-100:0)+(key==='spdPercent'&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0));
}

  /** Share the exact arrow angle with attacks, including cursor aiming. */
  function getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    let dx = vector[0];
    let dy = vector[1];
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride) {
      dx = state.pointer.x - x;
      dy = state.pointer.y - y;
      // Preserve facing if the cursor is precisely on the character anchor.
      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) [dx, dy] = vector;
    }
    return Math.atan2(dy, dx);
  }

  /** Draw an upward-native arrow rotated toward facing or the custom cursor. */
  function draw(context, character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    if (!arrow || !crosshair) return;
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';
import { createMalkuthHat, createRacerPass, createSafetyHelmet, createLifeJacket, createChisePlushie, createOverheatedOverclocking, createSpecialPharmaceuticals } from './item-catalog.js';
/** Repeat equip clicks level owned basic weapons; never awaken or enhance them. */
export function equipAdminWeapon(player,createWeapon){
  const candidate=createWeapon(),slots=player.attackSlots??=[],owned=slots.find(w=>w?.id===candidate.id);
  if(owned){
    const maximum=owned.isSynergy?1:(owned.maxLevel??candidate.maxLevel??7);
    const next=Math.min(maximum,(owned.level||1)+1);
    if(next>(owned.level||1)){owned.level=next;recordWeaponMax(player,owned);}
    return true;
  }
  const empty=slots.findIndex(w=>!w);
  if(empty>=0)slots[empty]=candidate;else if(slots.length<6)slots.push(candidate);else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,candidate);return true;
}

/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
}

/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
  if(owned) {
    if(product.kind==='item'&&product.weapon.isSuper&&!owned.isSuper&&!owned.awakened){Object.assign(owned,{...product.weapon});return true;}
    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
  }
  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
}

/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount, {projectile=false}={}) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if(character.supportState?.invulnerableRemaining>0||(projectile&&character.supportState?.shieldRemaining>0)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};return false;}
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula([].concat(character.damageReductionPercent??[],lifeJacketStats(character)?.reduction??0)));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};showDamageNumber(character,0,true,'miss');return false;}
  const initialFraction=chiseDelayConfigured()?chiseImmediateFraction(character):1;
  const immediate=Math.round(damage*initialFraction),deferred=damage-immediate;
  if(deferred>0){
    if(!(character.chisePendingDamage>0))character.chiseTickElapsed=0;
    character.chisePendingDamage=(character.chisePendingDamage||0)+deferred;
  }
  const taken=applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,immediate);
  character.lastDamageResult.deferredDamage=deferred;
  return taken||deferred>0;
}

/** Persistent miasma: renewal replaces the old field and never overlaps another copy. */
export function createBadCookingAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
  let owner=null,active=false,enabled=true,elapsed=0,cycle=0,time=0,hits=new Map(),mist=null;
  function reset(){owner=null;active=false;elapsed=0;cycle=0;time=0;hits.clear();}

        if(distance>radius+extent)continue;
        hits.set(enemy.id,time);

import { weaponSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage, startingWeaponTuning } from './combat-stats.js';

/** Locate Plana's equipped umbrella without selecting or switching active weapons. */
export function getUmbrella(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
}

/** Cumulative weapon-level bonuses; awakening is a separate state after level seven. */
export function umbrellaLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, getUmbrella(player)?.level || 1));
  const damageTiers = Number(level >= 2) + Number(level >= 5);
  const areaTiers = Number(level >= 3) + Number(level >= 6);
  return {
    level, damageMultiplier: (1 + umbrellaUpgradeSettings.damageIncrease) ** damageTiers,
    areaScale: weaponSizeMultiplier(player) * Math.sqrt(1 + areaTiers * umbrellaUpgradeSettings.areaIncrease) *
      (1+(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponTuning(player,'plana-umbrella','attackSizePercent'):0)/100),
    intervalMultiplier: (level >= 4 ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.intervalMultiplier : 1) *
      (1-(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponTuning(player,'plana-umbrella','attackTimeReductionPercent'):0)/100),
    guaranteedCritical: level >= 7,
    awakened: Boolean(getUmbrella(player)?.awakened)
  };
}

/** Nominal weapon damage only; all variation is applied after character ATK. */
export function umbrellaBaseDamage() {
  return umbrellaSettings.damage * umbrellaSettings.damageMultiplier;
}

/** Apply weapon upgrades first, then player ATK and the appropriate critical multiplier. */
export function rollUmbrellaDamage(player, base = umbrellaBaseDamage(), random = Math.random, damageMod = 1, target, {growthEligible=true,skillAttack=false} = {}) {
  const stats = umbrellaLevelStats(player);
  const hit=rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'plana-umbrella', base / 10,
    [ (stats.damageMultiplier - 1) * 100 ], { growthEligible, projectileCount: 1, hitCooldownFrames: umbrellaSettings.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, {
    damageMod, target, skillAttack, weaponId:'plana-umbrella', forceCritical: stats.guaranteedCritical,
    criticalMultiplier: stats.guaranteedCritical ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.finalCriticalMultiplier : undefined
  });
  if(stats.guaranteedCritical && hit.critical)hit.type='supercritical';
  return hit;
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;
    enemy.moving=false;return true; // Freeze also holds knockback and attack timers.
  }
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if(stunned)enemy.stunVisualElapsed=(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)+delta;
  else delete enemy.stunVisualElapsed;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

/** One-hit missiles choose random visible targets, then retain their launch trajectory. */
export function createSaintPredatorAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,missiles=[],shots=0;
 const s=saintPredatorSettings;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;missiles=[];shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),stats=saintPredatorLevelStats(weapon.level),size=s.area*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
  const view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const targets=getAllEnemies().filter(e=>{const b=getEnemyHurtbox(e);return b.x+b.rx>=view.x&&b.x-b.rx<=view.x+view.width&&b.y+b.ry>=view.y&&b.y-b.ry<=view.y+view.height;});
  const count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'saint-predator',stats.count);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const target=targets.length?targets[Math.min(targets.length-1,Math.floor(random()*targets.length))]:null,t=target?getEnemyHurtbox(target):null;
   const angle=t?Math.atan2(t.y-body.y,t.x-body.x):random()*Math.PI*2,dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
   const edge=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+s.radius*size+3;
   missiles.push({x:body.x+dx*edge,y:body.y+dy*edge,angle,age:0,size,speed:stats.speed,count,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses});shots++;
  }
 }
 function advance(delta,player){
  const enemies=getAllEnemies(),index=createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies,getEnemyHurtbox);
  for(let i=missiles.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=missiles[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-b.age),from={x:b.x,y:b.y};
   b.age+=step;b.x+=Math.cos(b.angle)*b.speed*step;b.y+=Math.sin(b.angle)*b.speed*step;
   const radius=s.radius*b.size;
   // Closest swept hit wins; each missile can deal damage to only one enemy.
   const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))return false;const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...t,rx:t.rx+radius,ry:t.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);});
   candidates.sort((a,c)=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(a),u=getEnemyHurtbox(c);return Math.hypot(t.x-from.x,t.y-from.y)-Math.hypot(u.x-from.x,u.y-from.y);});
   if(candidates.length){const target=candidates[0],hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'saint-predator',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,
     {projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target,weaponId:'saint-predator'});
    damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});missiles.splice(i,1);
   }else if(b.age>=s.duration-1e-8)missiles.splice(i,1);
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='saint-predator');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
  let left=delta;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,viewport);const stats=saintPredatorLevelStats(weapon.level);
    cooldown=attackTimeFormula(stats.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);advance(step,player);cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);left-=step;
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){context.save();for(const b of missiles){
  context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.rotate(b.angle);context.scale(b.size,b.size);
  const length=s.length,flame=8+3*Math.sin(b.age*55);
  context.fillStyle='rgba(255,135,49,.35)';context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-length/2,-4);context.lineTo(-length/2-flame,0);context.lineTo(-length/2,4);context.fill();
  context.fillStyle='#ffd66c';context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-length/2,-2);context.lineTo(-length/2-flame*.7,0);context.lineTo(-length/2,2);context.fill();

  context.fillStyle='#54636e';context.fillRect(-8,-5,5,10);context.fillStyle='#d5675c';context.fillRect(3,-3,3,6);context.restore();
 }context.restore();}
 return {ready:Promise.resolve(),update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return missiles.length;}};
}

export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= key==='critPercent'?(character.baseCritPercent??value):value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value+(key==='spdPercent'?(character.baseSPD??100)-100:0)+(key==='spdPercent'&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0));
}

import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
}

/** Travel at constant effect speed until duration expires or the mover reports collision. */
export function advanceKnockback(enemy, motion, delta, move) {
  motion.elapsed += Math.max(0, delta);
  const progress = Math.min(1, motion.elapsed / motion.duration);
  const step = progress - motion.applied;
  if (!motion.stopped && step > 0 && move(enemy, motion.dx * step, motion.dy * step) === false) motion.stopped = true;
  motion.applied = progress;
  return !motion.stopped && progress < 1;
}

/** Sweep living enemies and sample solid scenery; never slide or pass through a collision. */
export function createKnockbackMover(getEnemies, isClear) {
  return (enemy, dx, dy) => {
    const start = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
    const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (!length) return true;
    const candidates = getEnemies().filter(other => other !== enemy && (!enemy.id || other.id !== enemy.id))
      .map(other => ({ other, body: getCombatHitbox(other, true) }))
      .filter(({ body }) => Math.abs(body.x - start.x) <= Math.abs(dx) + body.rx + start.rx &&
        Math.abs(body.y - start.y) <= Math.abs(dy) + body.ry + start.ry);
    const stepSize = Math.max(.25, Math.min(knockbackSettings.collisionStep, start.rx / 2, start.ry / 2));
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(length / stepSize));
    const stepX = dx / steps, stepY = dy / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      const x = enemy.x + stepX, y = enemy.y + stepY;
      const body = getCombatHitbox({ ...enemy, x, y }, true);
      const previous = getCombatHitbox(enemy, true);
      const hit = candidates.find(({ body: other }) => segmentHitsBody({ ...other,
        rx: other.rx + body.rx, ry: other.ry + body.ry }, previous.x, previous.y, body.x, body.y));
      if (hit || !isClear(enemy, x, y)) {
        stopEnemyKnockback(enemy);
        if (hit) stopEnemyKnockback(hit.other);
        return false;
      }
      enemy.x = x; enemy.y = y;
    }
    return true;
  };
}

    drawPose(character, pose, 1);
  }
  character.lastPose = pose;
  drawCharacterOcclusion(character);
}

import {weakenedAttackMultiplier} from './weak-tuning.js';
import { enemyContactDamageFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

// Contact reaction settings live in game-config.js.
/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const enemyBody = getCombatHitbox(npc, true), playerBody = getCombatHitbox(player, false);
  const rx = enemyBody.rx + playerBody.rx, ry = enemyBody.ry + playerBody.ry;
  const fromX = playerBody.x - motion.x, fromY = playerBody.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const scaledLength = (motion.x / rx) ** 2 + (motion.y / ry) ** 2;
  const t = scaledLength ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((enemyBody.x - fromX) * motion.x / rx ** 2 +
      (enemyBody.y - fromY) * motion.y / ry ** 2) / scaledLength)) : 1;
  const dx = enemyBody.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
  const dy = enemyBody.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  const nx = distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1;
  const ny = distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0;
  const radius = 1 / Math.hypot(nx / rx, ny / ry);
  return { touching: (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2 < 1, pushing, radius, nx, ny,
    overlap: Math.max(0, radius - Math.hypot(enemyBody.x - playerBody.x, enemyBody.y - playerBody.y)) };
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move, survivalSeconds = 0) {
  if(npc.frozenRemaining>0)return false;
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  // Per-enemy attack cooldown is separate from recoil and the player's global I-frames.
  npc.playerHitCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.playerHitCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0) && !(npc.playerHitCooldown > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    const damage = npc.perTypeStats ? Math.floor(baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1)) :
      enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, player.level || 1, survivalSeconds, npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1);
    const damaged = damagePlayer(player, npc.weakRemaining>0?Math.floor(damage*weakenedAttackMultiplier(npc)):damage);
    if (damaged && npc.type === 'yuuka') npc.playerHitCooldown = yuukaSettings.contactHitInterval;
    if (damaged) {player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;npc.secondsSincePlayerHit=0;}
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = hit.overlap;
    const knockback = beginKnockback(npc, hit.nx * (settings.distance + overlap),
      hit.ny * (settings.distance + overlap), settings.travel);
    npc.contactReaction = knockback ? { ...knockback, kind, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny } : null;
    if (!knockback) npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  advanceKnockback(npc, reaction, delta, move);
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
  if (reaction.elapsed >= recovery) {
    npc.contactReaction = null;
    npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
  }
  // Bosses still recoil/flash, but do not skip their AI update or wait afterward.
  return pauseChase;
}

import {tuningPerk,slowdownTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
/** Temporary movement reduction, independent of permanent speed and knockback. */
export function applySlowdown(enemy,percent,seconds=5){
  if(enemy.hp<=0||!(percent>0)||!(seconds>0))return false;
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0,seconds);
  enemy.slowdownPercent=percent;return true;
}
export function updateSlowdown(enemy,delta){
  const dt=Math.max(0,delta),delay=enemy.waterRootDelay||0;
  enemy.waterRootDelay=Math.max(0,delay-dt);
  enemy.waterRootRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.waterRootRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,dt-delay));
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(enemy.slowdownRemaining<1e-6){enemy.slowdownRemaining=0;enemy.slowdownPercent=0;}
}

/** MAX weapons use their own energy color; awakening remains a separate upgrade. */
export function enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon) {
  if(weapon?.isSuper)return '#ffd45a';
  if(!weapon||!(weapon.level>=7))return '';
  // Plana's awakened outline/sparkles are handled by the existing CSS treatment.
  if(weapon.id==='plana-umbrella'&&weapon.awakened)return '';
  return weapon.id==='luminous-nova'?'#ff71d5':weapon.id==='aris-laser'?'#65cfff':'#ffd45a';
}

/** Apply the glow to the icon silhouette, never the surrounding inventory box. */
export function applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(element,weapon) {
  const color=enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon);
  element.style.filter=color?`drop-shadow(0 0 2px ${color}) drop-shadow(0 0 5px ${color})`:'';
}
import {tuningPerk,slowdownTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
/** Temporary movement reduction, independent of permanent speed and knockback. */
export function applySlowdown(enemy,percent,seconds=5){
  if(enemy.hp<=0||!(percent>0)||!(seconds>0))return false;
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0,seconds);
  enemy.slowdownPercent=percent;return true;
}
export function updateSlowdown(enemy,delta){
  const dt=Math.max(0,delta),delay=enemy.waterRootDelay||0;
  enemy.waterRootDelay=Math.max(0,delay-dt);
  enemy.waterRootRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.waterRootRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,dt-delay));
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(enemy.slowdownRemaining<1e-6){enemy.slowdownRemaining=0;enemy.slowdownPercent=0;}
}

/** Solve horizontal shell interception, including windup, travel time and player velocity. */
export function irohaCannonIntercept(npc,player,delta,motion={x:0,y:0}) {

/** List only equipped targets, keeping upgrades capped and offering only defined awakening paths. */
export function crafterChoices(player) {
  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{
      if(!target)return;
      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:
        target.id==='aris-laser'?arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel:target.maxLevel;
      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
      else if(kind==='weapon') {
        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} â€” ${cost} Credits â€” ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
      }
      if(kind==='item'&&target.id==='malkuth-hat'&&level>=max&&!target.awakened)
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:'Awaken - 1 Secret Tech Note',disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<1});
      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:`Awaken â€” ${umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost} Secret Tech Note`,disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<umbrellaUpgradeSettings.awakeningNoteCost});
      }
    });
  }
  return choices;
}

export function applyCrafterChoice(player,id,random=Math.random) {

  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;

/** Explicit fallback odds: 30% close, 60% middle, 10% far; randomized within each band. */
export function molotovThrowDistance(random=Math.random){
 const u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,random()));
 if(u<.3)return .05+.25*(u/.3);
 if(u<.9)return .3+.4*((u-.3)/.6);
 return .7+.3*((u-.9)/.1);
}

/** Prefer the nearest enemy in the middle 30-80% of directional screen reach. */
export function molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random=Math.random){
 const pad=Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.15;
 function reach(angle){const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
  const edgeX=Math.abs(dx)>1e-8?((dx>0?view.x+view.width+pad:view.x-pad)-body.x)/dx:Infinity;
  const edgeY=Math.abs(dy)>1e-8?((dy>0?view.y+view.height+pad:view.y-pad)-body.y)/dy:Infinity;
  return Math.max(20,Math.min(edgeX,edgeY));
 }
 let nearest=null,nearestDistance=Infinity;
 for(const enemy of enemies){
  const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=target.x-body.x,dy=target.y-body.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  const fraction=distance/reach(Math.atan2(dy,dx));
  if(fraction>=.3&&fraction<=.8&&distance<nearestDistance){nearest=target;nearestDistance=distance;}
 }
 if(nearest)return {x:nearest.x,y:nearest.y};
 const angle=random()*Math.PI*2,distance=reach(angle)*molotovThrowDistance(random);
 return {x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance};
}

export function createMolotovAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,cooldown=0,time=0,enabled=true,throws=[],fires=[],shots=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;throws=[];fires=[];shots=0;}
 function launch(player,stats,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const enemies=getAllEnemies();
  for(let i=0;i<stats.count;i++){
   const {x,y}=molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random);
   throws.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:x,toY:y,age:0,
    flight:Math.max(.12,Math.hypot(x-body.x,y-body.y)/molotovSettings.speed),
    radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),duration:stats.duration,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count:stats.count});shots++;
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='molotov-cocktail');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
  let left=delta;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,molotovLevelStats(weapon.level),viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(molotovSettings.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;time+=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
   for(let i=throws.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=throws[i];b.age+=step;const progress=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight);b.x=b.fromX+(b.toX-b.fromX)*progress;b.y=b.fromY+(b.toY-b.fromY)*progress;
    if(progress>=1){fires.push({...b,x:b.toX,y:b.toY,age:0,hits:new Map()});throws.splice(i,1);}}
   const enemies=getAllEnemies(),living=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
   for(let i=fires.length-1;i>=0;i--){const zone=fires[i];zone.age+=step;
    if(zone.age>=zone.duration){fires.splice(i,1);continue;}
    for(const id of zone.hits.keys())if(!living.has(id))zone.hits.delete(id);
    for(const enemy of enemies){if(time-(zone.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<molotovSettings.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
     const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=t.x-zone.x,dy=t.y-zone.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/t.rx,dy/distance/t.ry):0;
     if(distance>zone.radius+extent)continue;zone.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'molotov-cocktail',molotovSettings.damage,zone.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:zone.count,hitCooldownFrames:45}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'molotov-cocktail'});
     damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
    }
   }
  }
 }
 function drawGround(context,camera){for(const zone of fires)drawMolotovNapalm(context,camera,zone);}
 function drawThrows(context,camera){context.save();for(const b of throws){const arc=Math.sin(Math.PI*b.age/b.flight)*45;
  context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y-arc);context.rotate(b.age*7);context.fillStyle='#746533';context.fillRect(-4,-7,8,14);context.fillStyle='#d3cca5';context.fillRect(-2,-11,4,5);context.fillStyle='#ffb64d';context.fillRect(-2,-14,4,4);context.restore();}context.restore();}

}

/** One successful proc per attack/projectile; splash never re-enters this function. */
export function tryTuningExplosion({player,projectile,enemy,rollDamage,onHit=null,random=Math.random,weaponId="plana-umbrella"}){

  if(weaponId!==main||!player.tuningParts||triggered.has(projectile))return false;

    if(Math.hypot(body.x-zone.x,body.y-zone.y)>zone.radius+Math.max(body.rx,body.ry))continue;

    const hpBefore=target.hp;
    const landed=damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{tuningExplosion:true,weaponId:'plana-umbrella'});

    if(landed){if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'weakChance')>0)tryWeakTuningHit({player,enemy:target});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowChance')>0)trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy:target,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollDamage(target,multiplier,{growthEligible:false})});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'stunChance')>0)tryNeutralizationHit({player,enemy:target});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'targetPercent')>0)shareTargetTuningDamage({player,enemy:target,damage:Math.min(hpBefore,hit.damage),hitType:hit.type});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'repairMaxHpPercent')>0)tryRepairTuningHit({player});if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'creditChancePercent')>0)tryLuxeryTuningHit({player,enemy:target,damage:hit.damage});if(onHit)onHit(landed);else if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackFrames')>0)applyTuningKnockback(player,landed);if(tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'coldDamagePercent')>0)tryColdTuningHit({player,enemy:landed,rollDamage:(target,multiplier)=>rollDamage(target,multiplier,{growthEligible:false})});}
  }
  return true;
}

    critical, type: critical ? 'critical' : 'normal' };
}

/** Parts affect only the explicitly identified character starting weapon. */
export function startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,key) {
  const main=character.mainWeaponId??(character.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  return main&&weaponId===main&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,key):0;
}

/** Build weapon damage with independent level bonuses and optional purchased Growth.
 * mainWeaponId can explicitly identify a character main weapon; Plana defaults to her umbrella.
 */
export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  const soloBonus=character.tuningParts&&options.soloTuningEligible!==false&&weapon?.soloTuningEligible!==false?startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'soloDamagePerEmptyPercent')*emptyWeaponSlotCount(character):0;
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, [...bonusesPercent,startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'damagePercent'),-startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'weaponDamagePenaltyPercent'),soloBonus,character.tuningParts&&stationaryTuningActive(character)?startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'stationaryDamagePercent'):0,character.tuningParts?weaponTuningDamageBonus(character,weaponId):0], {
    ...options, projectileCount:character.tuningParts?startingWeaponProjectileCount(character,weaponId,options.projectileCount??weapon?.attackCount??1):(options.projectileCount??weapon?.attackCount??1), enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: options.growthEligible===false?0:(character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank), playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}


/** Add the accumulated item/skill ATK bonus to the character's independent base ATK. */
export function totalCharacterATK(character) {
  return totalATKFormula(character.baseATK ?? attackStatSettings.baseATK,
    [Number(ensureCombatStats(character).atkPercent),overclockingStats(character).atk]);
}


/** Add character and weapon critical damage bonuses; overrides replace only the base.
 * criticalMultiplier is an optional weapon base override (e.g. Umbrella LV7=3).
 * critDamagePercent contains accumulated bonuses, separate from critical chance.
 */
export function characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponBonus = 0) {
  const base = criticalMultiplier !== undefined ? (criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100 :
    (character.baseCritMod ?? (combatBalance.criticalMultiplier - 1) * 100);
  const bonus = ensureCombatStats(character).critDamagePercent;
  return Math.max(0, 1 + totalCritModFormula(base, [bonus, weaponBonus]) / 100);
}

import { waterDousingSettings, waterDousingLevelStats, weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { beginKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Sprite ellipses overlap a closed sector; sample its curved boundary without inflating hurtboxes. */
export function waterConeHits(body,x,y,angle,radius,halfAngle=waterDousingSettings.halfAngle){
 const dx=body.x-x,dy=body.y-y,relative=Math.atan2(Math.sin(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-angle),Math.cos(Math.atan2(dy,dx)-angle));
 if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<=radius&&Math.abs(relative)<=halfAngle)return true;
 let previous={x,y};
 for(let i=0;i<=24;i++){
  const a=angle-halfAngle+2*halfAngle*i/24,next={x:x+Math.cos(a)*radius,y:y+Math.sin(a)*radius};
  if(segmentHitsBody(body,previous.x,previous.y,next.x,next.y))return true;previous=next;
 }
 return segmentHitsBody(body,previous.x,previous.y,x,y);
}
/** Each attack splashes once; independent splashes use the configured per-target hit cooldown. */
export function createWaterDousingAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=waterDousingSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,splashes=[],hits=new Map(),shots=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;splashes=[];hits.clear();shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,angle){
  const stats=waterDousingLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),radius=stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
  splashes.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,angle,radius,age:0});shots++;
  const enemies=getAllEnemies(),live=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));for(const id of hits.keys())if(!live.has(id))hits.delete(id);
  for(const enemy of enemies){
   if(time-(hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8||!waterConeHits(getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),body.x,body.y,angle,radius))continue;
   hits.set(enemy.id,time);
   const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'water-dousing',s.damage,stats.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'water-dousing'});
   if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true})===false)continue;
   const target=getEnemy(enemy.id);if(!target)continue;
   const b=getEnemyHurtbox(target),a=Math.atan2(b.y-body.y,b.x-body.x),distance=stats.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
   const motion=beginKnockback(target,Math.cos(a)*distance,Math.sin(a)*distance,s.knockbackSeconds);
   if(motion){target.skillKnockback=motion;target.waterRootDelay=s.knockbackSeconds;}
   if(stats.rootSeconds){target.waterRootDelay=motion?s.knockbackSeconds:0;target.waterRootRemaining=stats.rootSeconds;}
  }

// Plana's first drawing skill: circle enclosing an upper arrow and a lower X.
export const planaSkillSettings = {
  stunSeconds: 3, openingSeconds: 0.28, prelaunchSeconds: 0.08,
  projectileSpeed: 2520, maxDistance: 800, hitRadius: 80, displayLength: 115.2, // Fixed px/s; unaffected by player SPD or Haste.
  trailSeconds: 0.20, trailSpacing: 10, trailBlur: 5, maxTrailImages: 96,
  knockbackDistance: 72, knockbackSeconds: 0.22, ignoreKnockbackResistance: false,
  ringInnerRadius: 0.78,
  circleRadialTolerance: 0.23, lineSimplifyRatio: 0.035, joinToleranceRatio: 0.13
};

// Enemy damage scales with current player level and active survival minutes.
export const enemyDamageScaling = { base: 1, levelDivisor: 6, minutesDivisor: 4 };

/** floor(enemyBase * variantMultiplier * (1 + (level/6) * (minutes/4))). */
export function enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, level, survivalSeconds, variantMultiplier = 1) {
  const s = enemyDamageScaling;
  const minutes = Math.max(0, survivalSeconds) / 60;
  const scale = s.base + (Math.max(1, level) / s.levelDivisor) * (minutes / s.minutesDivisor);
  return Math.max(0, Math.floor(baseDamage * variantMultiplier * scale));
}

/** Sweep a broad projectile capsule against an enemy's scaled body ellipse. */
export function umbrellaSkillHits(enemy, from, to, radius = planaSkillSettings.hitRadius) {
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + radius, ry: body.ry + radius }, from.x, from.y, to.x, to.y);
}

/** Boss identity is explicit, never inferred from an elite's enlarged sprite. */
export function isBossEnemy(enemy) {
  if(enemy.boss === false) return false;
  return enemy.boss === true || ['iroha', 'shiroko', 'arisu', 'neru'].includes(enemy.type);
}

/** Render special enemies above normal actors, while bosses always own the final layer. */
export function enemyRenderLayer(enemy) {
  if (isBossEnemy(enemy)) return 'boss';
  return enemy.special === true || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? 'special' : 'normal';
}

/** Measure distance from sprite edges to the gameplay viewport rectangle. */
export function enemyViewportDistance(enemy, camera, width, height) {
  const radius = (enemy.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize) / 2;
  const dx = Math.max(camera.x - (enemy.x + radius), enemy.x - radius - camera.x - width, 0);
  const dy = Math.max(camera.y - (enemy.y + radius), enemy.y - radius - camera.y - height, 0);
  return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}

const enemies = new Map();
const spawnListeners = new Set();
const defeatListeners = new Set();
const damageListeners = new Set();
let killCount = 0;

export const enemyTestConfig = { oneHp: isAdminSeed };
const savedEnemyHealth = new WeakMap();

/** Toggle 1-HP enemies for this session, including elites, bosses and future spawns. */
export function setOneHpEnemies(enabled) {
  enemyTestConfig.oneHp = Boolean(enabled);
  for (const enemy of enemies.values()) applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
}

/** Preserve normal health so disabling the test restores surviving enemies. */
function applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy) {
  if (enemyTestConfig.oneHp) {
    if (!savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, { hp: enemy.hp, maxHp: enemy.maxHp });
    enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp = 1;
  } else if (savedEnemyHealth.has(enemy)) {
    Object.assign(enemy, savedEnemyHealth.get(enemy));
    savedEnemyHealth.delete(enemy);
  }
}

/** Observe real spawns/defeats; cleanup removals never emit these events. */
export function onEnemySpawn(listener) {
  spawnListeners.add(listener);
  return () => spawnListeners.delete(listener);
}
export function onEnemyDefeat(listener) {
  defeatListeners.add(listener);
  return () => defeatListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Count confirmed defeats for this session; admin removal does not count. */
export function getKillCount() {
  return killCount;
}

/** Return all session records, including enemies outside the camera view. */
export function getAllEnemies() {
  return [...enemies.values()];
}

/** Observe accepted HP damage, excluding misses, overkill and forced harmless-enemy removal. */
export function onEnemyDamage(listener) {
  damageListeners.add(listener);return ()=>damageListeners.delete(listener);
}

/** Explicitly clear the test population without affecting player state. */
export function clearEnemies() {
  enemies.clear();
}

/** Add or update an enemy's state without tying its lifetime to camera visibility. */
export function rememberEnemy(id, state) {
  const existed = enemies.has(id);
  const enemy = { ...enemies.get(id), ...state, id };
  const saved = savedEnemyHealth.get(enemies.get(id));
  if (saved) savedEnemyHealth.set(enemy, saved);
  applyEnemyHealthTest(enemy);
  enemies.set(id, enemy);
  if (!existed) for (const listener of spawnListeners) listener(enemy);
  return enemy;
}

/** Read a remembered enemy even after its background tile has left the screen. */
export function getEnemy(id) {
  return enemies.get(id);
}

/** Apply damage and trigger a brief sprite pulse; remove defeated test enemies. */
export function damageEnemy(id, amount, source, hitType = 'normal', options = {}) {
  const enemy = enemies.get(id);
  if (!enemy || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
  if (options.instantKO && (isBossEnemy(enemy) || enemy.miniBoss || enemy.instantKOImmune)) return false;
  if (options.canMiss && midoriDodges(enemy, source)) {
    showDamageNumber(enemy, 0, false, 'miss');
    return false;
  }
  const mainWeaponId=source?.mainWeaponId??(source?.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(source?.tuningParts&&options.weaponId===mainWeaponId)recordRateUpHit(enemy,tuningPerk(source.tuningParts,'rateUpChance'));
  const harmless = ['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type);
  if (harmless) {
    dropYuukaCredits(enemy); // Each accepted hit, including the final hit.
    enemy.receivedHits = (enemy.receivedHits || 0) + 1;
  }
  const requiredHits = harmless ? (enemy.hitsToDefeat ?? harmlessEnemySettings[`${enemy.type}HitsToDefeat`]) : null;
  const actualDamage=Math.min(enemy.hp,amount);
  enemy.hp = Math.max(0, enemy.hp - amount);
  for(const listener of damageListeners)listener({enemy,source,damage:actualDamage,requestedDamage:amount,hitType});
  // Count accepted hits, not damage points; misses and rejected hits never reach this branch.
  if (Number.isFinite(requiredHits) && requiredHits >= 1 && enemy.receivedHits >= requiredHits) enemy.hp = 0;
  showDamageNumber(enemy, amount, false, hitType, options.damageGroup); // Include overkill and crit styling.
  enemy.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
  if (enemy.hp === 0) {
    const bossesAliveBefore = [...enemies.values()].filter(isBossEnemy).length;
    killCount++;
    dropEnemyExp(enemy);
    dropEnemyLoot(enemy);
    beginEnemyDeath(enemy, source);
    enemies.delete(id);
    for (const listener of defeatListeners) listener({ enemy, bossesAliveBefore });
  }
  return enemy;
}

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  const superWeapon=character.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton');
  if(superWeapon&&!character.ultimateSkill)character.ultimateSkill={id:'decagrammaton-ultimate',name:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',icon:superWeapon.icon,exSkill:true,successCooldown:300};
  if(!superWeapon&&character.ultimateSkill?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate')delete character.ultimateSkill;
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

import { defaultCombatStats, combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= key==='critPercent'?(character.baseCritPercent??value):value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value+(key==='spdPercent'?(character.baseSPD??100)-100:0)+(key==='spdPercent'&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0));
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target, weaponId, skillAttack = false } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus + sportsDrinkCritBonus(character) - itemCritPenalty(character) + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critChancePercent'))) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critDamagePercent')) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula([].concat(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent??[],target?.weakRemaining>0?target.weakDefensePercent:0)),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,itemDamageBonus(character),...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
    attackModifier: damageMod*(skillAttack?itemSkillDamageMultiplier(character):1) // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.
  });
  return { damage: attackDamageFormula(totalWeaponDamage, totalCharacterATK(character), combinedModifier, random),
    critical, type: critical ? 'critical' : 'normal' };

/** Offer acquisition or the next Aris upgrade, plus existing umbrella choices. */
export function rollLevelUpgrades(player, {all=false}={}) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const choices = umbrellaChoices(player);
  // Fusion ingredients stay out of the upgrade pool while their synergy is equipped.
  const blocked=new Set((player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).flatMap(item=>
    item.consumedWeaponIds||(item.id==='princess-key'?['aris-laser','luminous-nova']:[])));
  const weapon = getArisWeapon(player);
  if (!blocked.has('aris-laser') && !weapon && isContentUnlocked('aris-laser') && (player.attackSlots || []).filter(Boolean).length < 6) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-new', name: "Supernova LV 1", weapon: createArisWeapon(), category: 'NEW Weapon',
    description: 'Shoot a powerful piercing laser beam every 3 seconds.'
  });
  else if (!blocked.has('aris-laser') && weapon && (weapon.level || 1) < arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel) choices.push({
    id: 'aris-level', name: `Supernova ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon',
    description: arisDescriptions[(weapon.level || 1) + 1]
  });

const limits={reroll:10,eliminate:10,hold:5};
export function levelActionUses(player,action){
  const purchased=Math.max(0,Math.min(limits[action],Math.trunc(Number(player.abilityUpgradeRanks?.[action])||0)));
  const granted=isContentUnlocked('developer-level-actions')?limits[action]:purchased;
  return Math.max(0,granted-(player.levelActionSpent?.[action]||0));
}
export function spendLevelAction(player,action){
  if(!levelActionUses(player,action))return false;
  player.levelActionSpent??={};player.levelActionSpent[action]=(player.levelActionSpent[action]||0)+1;return true;
}
export function levelActionChoices(player,pool,random=Math.random){
  const remaining=pool.slice(),choices=[];
  while(remaining.length){
    const weight=choice=>Math.max(0,Number(choice.weapon?.weight??1)||0),total=remaining.reduce((sum,c)=>sum+weight(c),0);
    let roll=random()*total,index=remaining.length-1;
    for(let i=0;i<remaining.length;i++){roll-=weight(remaining[i]);if(roll<0){index=i;break;}}
    choices.push(...remaining.splice(index,1));
  }
  const held=choices.findIndex(choice=>choice.id===player.heldUpgradeId);
  if(held>=0)choices.unshift(...choices.splice(held,1));
  return choices;
}

/** Count real defeats and snapshot scores without inventing leaderboard/results placement. */
export function createRunScore() {
  let counts = { enemyDefeated: 0, miniBossDefeated: 0, bossDefeated: 0 };
  let endlessDefeatRecorded = false;
  const results = [];
  return {
    recordDefeat(enemy) {
      counts.enemyDefeated++;
      if (enemy.miniBoss) counts.miniBossDefeated++;
      else if (enemy.boss || (enemy.boss !== false && ['iroha','shiroko'].includes(enemy.type))) counts.bossDefeated++;
    },
    complete({ character, elapsedSeconds, stage, endless = false, hardcore = false }) {
      if (endless && endlessDefeatRecorded) return null;
      if (endless) endlessDefeatRecorded = true;
      const result = Object.freeze({ ...scoreFormula({ ...counts, playerLevel: character.level || 1,
        elapsedSeconds, hardcore }), ...counts, character: character.label, stage,
        playerLevel: character.level || 1, mode: endless ? 'endless' : 'stage', elapsedSeconds });
      results.push(result);

  const glyphs = [...text].filter(letter => letter !== ' ').map(glyphRectangle);
  const textWidth = [...text].reduce((sum, letter) => sum +
    (letter === ' ' ? 3 : glyphRectangle(letter).width - 1), 1);
  const inkBottom = Math.max(...glyphs.map(glyph => glyph.offsetY + glyph.height));
  const nextBoxInset = slotWidth * (1 - 237 / 255) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, slotWidth * 0.9 * inkBottom / textWidth - 6 - nextBoxInset);
}

/** Keep the equipment frame 2px below the lowest visible attack-level outline. */
function updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries) {
  const visible=entries.filter(entry=>!entry.caption.hidden);
  if(!visible.length){container.style.setProperty('--level-space','0px');return;}
  const textWidth=text=>[...text].reduce((sum,letter)=>sum+(letter===' '?3:glyphRectangle(letter).width-1),1);
  // Scale the entire row together. Fitting each label independently makes LV1 and LV7
  // different heights because their digit glyphs have different widths.
  const scale=Math.min(...visible.map(entry=>entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*.9/textWidth(entry.captionText)));
  let spacing = 0;
  for (const entry of visible) {
    entry.caption.style.width=`${textWidth(entry.captionText)*scale}px`;
    entry.caption.style.height=`${20*scale}px`;
    const inkBottom=Math.max(...[...entry.captionText].filter(letter=>letter!==' ').map(letter=>{
      const glyph=glyphRectangle(letter);return glyph.offsetY+glyph.height;
    }));
    const nextBoxInset=entry.slot.getBoundingClientRect().width*(1-237/255)/2;
    spacing=Math.max(spacing,inkBottom*scale-6-nextBoxInset);
  }
  container.style.setProperty('--level-space', `${spacing}px`);
}

/** Arrange HUD values/portrait without introducing combat or experience mechanics. */
export function createHud(getFrameRectangle) {
  const exp = document.querySelector('#hud-exp');
  const expFill = document.querySelector('#hud-exp-fill');
  const expEdge = document.querySelector('#hud-exp-edge');
  const hp = document.querySelector('#hud-hp');
  const hpFill = document.querySelector('#hud-hp-fill');
  const shieldFill = document.querySelector('#hud-shield-fill');
  const shieldEdge = document.querySelector('#hud-shield-edge');
  const hpNumbers = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-hp-numbers'), { scale: 1 });
  const portrait = document.querySelector('#hud-portrait');
  const support=document.querySelector('#hud-support'),supportGraphic=support.querySelector('.hud-support-icon'),supportCooldown=support.querySelector('.hud-slot-cooldown');let previousSupport;
  function updateSupportIcon(character){const item=supportItems.find(item=>item.id===character.supportItemId);support.hidden=!item||item.id==='none'||!supportsUnlocked(character);if(support.hidden)return;if(previousSupport!==item.id){previousSupport=item.id;supportGraphic.innerHTML=supportIcon(item.id);}const remaining=Math.max(0,character.supportState?.cooldowns?.[item.id]||0);supportCooldown.hidden=remaining<=0;supportCooldown.style.setProperty('--cooldown-sweep',`${Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-remaining/item.cooldown))*360}deg`);support.setAttribute('aria-label',remaining>0?`${item.name}, cooldown ${Math.ceil(remaining)} seconds`:`${item.name}, ready`);}
  const level = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-level'));
  const creditsText = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-credits'), { scale: 1.25 });
  const killsText = createBitmapText(document.querySelector('#hud-kills'), { scale: 1.25 });
  const context = portrait.getContext('2d');
  let previousImage;
  let previousName;
  const profiles = new Map();
  let activeCharacter;

  /** Create six compact slots per row once, then update only changed artwork. */
  function createSlots(container, type) {
    const entries = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => {
      const slot = document.createElement('div');
      slot.className = 'hud-slot';
      slot.setAttribute('role', 'img');
      const base = document.createElement('img');
      base.alt = '';
      const icon = document.createElement('canvas');
      icon.width = icon.height = 128;
      icon.className = 'hud-slot-icon';
      icon.hidden = true;
      const caption = document.createElement('canvas');
      caption.className = 'hud-slot-level';
      caption.hidden = true;
      const levelText = createBitmapText(caption, { scale: 1, fitWidth: '90%' });
      const cooldown = document.createElement('div');
      cooldown.className = 'hud-slot-cooldown';
      cooldown.hidden = true; cooldown.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      slot.append(base, cooldown, icon, caption);
      container.append(slot);
      return { slot, base, icon, caption, cooldown, levelText, type, index, previous: null, container };
    });
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => updateCaptionRowSpacing(container, entries));
    observer.observe(container);
    return entries;
  }
  const attackSlots = createSlots(document.querySelector('#hud-attack-slots'), 'attack');
  const equipmentSlots = createSlots(document.querySelector('#hud-equipment-slots'), 'equipment');

  /** Occupied slots use a blank base so placeholder swords/clothes never show through. */
  function updateSlots(slots, items = []) {
    let changed = false;
    for (const entry of slots) {
      const item = items[entry.index];
      entry.slot.classList.toggle('weapon-awakened', Boolean(item?.awakened));
      const ultimateReady=entry.type==='attack'&&item?.id==='decagrammaton'&&!(activeCharacter?.ultimateSkill?.skillCooldownRemaining>0);
      entry.slot.classList.toggle('ultimate-ready',ultimateReady);
      entry.slot.setAttribute('data-ultimate-ready',String(ultimateReady));
      entry.slot.classList.toggle('weapon-synergy',entry.type==='attack'&&Boolean(item?.isSynergy));
      applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(entry.icon,item);
      const source = item?.icon || '';
      const remaining = item?.skillCooldownRemaining || 0;
      entry.cooldown.hidden = remaining <= 0;
      const duration = Math.max(1, item?.skillCooldownDuration || 1);
      entry.cooldown.style.setProperty('--cooldown-sweep', `${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - remaining / duration)) * 360}deg`);
      entry.slot.setAttribute('aria-description', remaining > 0 ? `Skill cooldown ${Math.ceil(remaining)} seconds` : '');
      const label = source ? item.name || `${entry.type} ${entry.index + 1}`
        : `Empty ${entry.type} slot ${entry.index + 1}`;
    const playerLevel = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(character.level) || 1));
    level.setText(`LV: ${playerLevel}`);
    const maximumHp = Math.max(1, character.maxHp ?? 100);
    const health = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximumHp, character.hp ?? maximumHp));
    hpNumbers.setText(`${Math.ceil(health)}/${maximumHp}`);
    const maximumExp = Math.max(1, character.maxExp ?? 100);
    const experience = Math.max(0, Math.min(maximumExp, character.exp ?? 0));
    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(maximumHp));
    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(health));
    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${health} / ${maximumHp} HP`);
    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuemax', String(maximumExp));
    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(experience));
    exp.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${experience} / ${maximumExp} EXP`);
    // HP artwork is 643px wide; actual fill occupies source columns 72..628.
    // Map health to that interior so labels/end framing do not distort progress.
    const hpRightInset = health === 0 ? 100 : health === maximumHp ? 0
      : (643 - (72 + 557 * health / maximumHp)) / 643 * 100;
    hpFill.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${hpRightInset}% 0 0)`;
    const shield = totalPlayerShield(character);
    shieldFill.hidden = shield === 0;
    const shieldRightInset = (643 - (72 + 557 * Math.min(shield,maximumHp) / maximumHp)) / 643 * 100;
    shieldFill.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${shieldRightInset}% 0 0)`;
    // Match the animated fill boundary, using the shield artwork's interior columns.
    shieldEdge.style.left = `${100 - shieldRightInset}%`;
    shieldEdge.hidden = shield === 0;
    hp.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', `${health} / ${maximumHp} HP; ${shield} shield`);
    const percent = experience / maximumExp * 100;
    // Caps use their own filled artwork; only the middle is proportionally clipped.
    expFill.style.setProperty('--exp-unfilled', `${100 - percent}%`);
    expFill.dataset.hasExp = String(experience > 0);
    expFill.dataset.full = String(experience === maximumExp);
    // The middle starts after the 90px left cap and ends before the 15px right cap.
    expEdge.style.left = `calc(${percent}% + ${90 - 105 * percent / 100}px)`;
    expEdge.hidden = experience === 0;
    activeCharacter = character;
    updateSlots(attackSlots, character.attackSlots);
    updateSlots(equipmentSlots, character.equipmentSlots);
    if (previousImage === character.image && previousName === character.label) return;
    previousImage = character.image;
    previousName = character.label;
    portrait.setAttribute('aria-label', `${character.label} portrait`);
    context.clearRect(0, 0, portrait.width, portrait.height);
    const profile = profiles.get(character.label);
    if (profile) {
      // Preserve the entire profile and its proportions, with crisp pixel artwork.
      context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      const scale = Math.min(portrait.width / profile.naturalWidth, portrait.height / profile.naturalHeight);
      const width = profile.naturalWidth * scale;
      const height = profile.naturalHeight * scale;
      context.drawImage(profile, (portrait.width - width) / 2, (portrait.height - height) / 2, width, height);
      return;
    }
    context.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    const image = character.animationFrames?.[0].image || character.image;
    const pose = { ...character, direction: character.defaultDirection || 'down', moving: false, attack: null };
    const crop = character.animationFrames
      ? { x: 0, y: 0, width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight }
      : getFrameRectangle(pose, 0);
    // Focus on the upper body/face; use the source sheet without editing the asset.
    const side = Math.min(crop.width, crop.height * 0.65);
    context.drawImage(image, crop.x + (crop.width - side) / 2, crop.y,
      side, side, 0, 0, portrait.width, portrait.height);
  }
  return { update, setSlot };
}

const buffKey='luminous-nova-ex';

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction*itemSkillDamageMultiplier(player)),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));
}

/** Nominal281% ATK before the normal damage roll; the banked extra is calculated separately. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherBaseDamage(player) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(damageRules.baseScale*skill.finisherAttackMultiplier*totalCharacterATK(player)/100*itemSkillDamageMultiplier(player)));
}

- **Celestia'**&#x73; duration is refreshed when Plana makes another critical hit.
- The damage from **Celestia&#x20;**&#x69;s displayed as a critical hit, but it is *not treated* as one. This means it cannot trigger EX skills, refresh **Celestia'**&#x73; ATK buff nor trigger its damage effect (using its own damage for calculation to deal the same damage one more time). This is intended in the codes.
- **Celestia'**&#x73; damage inherits Plana's critical damage modifier, for display purpose only. If she is having equal or more than 50% bonus critical hit damage (currently the only way to do this is to have a max leveled [item not added yet]), **Plana'**&#x73; damage will be displayed in orange like all of her critical hits.
  - However, it does not actually inherit this from weapons with critical damage modifier of their own. For example, if Plana would trigger **Celestia&#x20;**&#x74;hrough Umbrella Swing Awakened which always displays its damage in red, **Celestia'**&#x73; damage would still be displayed in its default color yellow, or orange if the forementioned condition is met.

export { defaultCombatStats } from './game-config.js';
// Percent bonuses: zero keeps base values. CRIT is a direct chance percentage.


/** Initialize independent per-character combat stats without resetting upgrades. */
export function ensureCombatStats(character) {
  character.combatStats ??= {};
  character.combatStats.damageBonusMultipliers ??= [];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(defaultCombatStats)) character.combatStats[key] ??= key==='critPercent'?(character.baseCritPercent??value):value;
  return character.combatStats;
}

/** Convert a bonus percentage to a multiplier (25% means 1.25 times base). */
export function statMultiplier(character, key) {
  const value = Number(ensureCombatStats(character)[key]);
  if (key === 'atkPercent') return totalCharacterATK(character) / 100;
  return percentBonusFormula(value+(key==='spdPercent'?(character.baseSPD??100)-100:0)+(key==='spdPercent'&&character.tuningParts?tuningPerk(character.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0));
}

/** Format normal hits, yellow critical hits, or red supercrit visuals. */
export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if (hitType === 'miss') return { text: 'MISS', color: '#ffffff', italic: true };
  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
  if (hitType === 'shield') return { text, color: '#62cfff', italic: false };
  if (player) return { text, color: '#ff5265', italic: false };
  if (hitType === 'supercritical') return { text: `${text}!!!`, color: '#ff5265', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  if (hitType === 'critical') return { text: `${text}!`, color: '#ffe15a', italic: true, scale: 1.1 };
  return { text, color: '#ffffff', italic: false };
}

/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal', group = null) {
  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  // Only the synergy accumulates rapid hits, independently for each enemy and damage source.
  if(group&&hitType!=='miss') {
    const existing=numbers.findLast(number=>number.target===target&&number.group===group&&!number.closed);
    if(existing&&existing.hitType===hitType&&existing.sinceHit<=.3) {
      existing.amount+=amount;existing.sinceHit=0;existing.elapsed=0;
      Object.assign(existing,{scale:1},damageNumberStyle(existing.amount,player,existing.hitType));
      existing.x=target.x;existing.y=target.y-(target.spriteSize||112)*.4;return;
    }
    // A changed hit type ends this run permanently; its popup continues its existing fade.
    if(existing)existing.closed=true;
  }
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    target,group,amount,hitType,closed:false,sinceHit:0,drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    numbers[i].sinceHit += delta;
    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}
